newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela revises 97 fiscal surplus to 1.4 pct GDP.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela revises 97 fiscal surplus to 1.4 pct GDP.

text.p: Venezuela projects a fiscal surplus equivalent to 1.4 percent of gross domestic product in 1997, down from an earlier forecast of 1.59 percent, according to revised figures, a Finance Ministry source told Reuters.
Venezuela registered its first fiscal surplus for years in 1996 with a margin of 0.9 percent of GDP.
Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said in May that Venezuela was on target for a 1.59 percent GDP surplus this year. The source gave no explanation for the revision in the surplus projection.
Venezuela raised gasoline prices 27 percent Thursday which officials have said will bring in an extra 45 billion bolivars ($91 million) this year.
